helpCenter.hero_sub: Find answers to common questions. Explore our comprehensive guides and documentation.
helpCenter.cta_sub: Contact our support team anytime. We're here to help you succeed.
helpCenter.cat_booking_q1: How do I book a service on ONE TOUCH?
helpCenter.cat_booking_a1: Browse available services, select a provider, call them via in-app VoIP to confirm details and pricing, then book through the platform. You'll receive instant confirmation.
helpCenter.cat_booking_q2: Can I reschedule or cancel a booking?
helpCenter.cat_booking_a2: Yes, you can reschedule or cancel up to 2 hours before the scheduled time without penalty. Late cancellations may result in fees.
helpCenter.cat_booking_q3: What if the provider doesn't show up?
helpCenter.cat_booking_a3: If a provider doesn't arrive as scheduled, contact our support team immediately. Your payment will be refunded and you'll be offered an alternative provider.
helpCenter.cat_booking_q4: How do I know if a provider is verified?
helpCenter.cat_booking_a4: All providers on ONE TOUCH are verified through government ID checks. Look for the Verified badge on their profile.
helpCenter.cat_payments_q1: What payment methods do you accept?
helpCenter.cat_payments_a1: We accept mobile money (Telebirr, M-Pesa), bank transfers, and card payments. All payments are processed securely through our escrow system.
helpCenter.cat_payments_a2: Payment is held safely until you confirm the job is complete. Once confirmed, the provider receives the payment instantly.
helpCenter.cat_payments_a3: Refunds are available if the service wasn't completed as agreed. Contact support within 24 hours with evidence, and we'll investigate and process refunds.
helpCenter.cat_payments_a4: ONE TOUCH charges a small platform fee (varies by service) to process payments securely and maintain the platform.
helpCenter.cat_provider_q1: How do I become a service provider?
helpCenter.cat_provider_a1: Sign up as a provider, pass our identity verification, and upload your credentials. Setup takes 2-3 business days.
helpCenter.cat_provider_a2: Valid government ID, proof of skills/certifications (where applicable), and a reliable phone with internet access.
helpCenter.cat_provider_q3: How do I set my rates?
helpCenter.cat_provider_a3: You control your pricing. Set hourly rates or fixed prices per service. Adjust anytime from your dashboard.
helpCenter.cat_provider_q4: How do I build my reputation?
helpCenter.cat_provider_a4: Deliver quality work, respond quickly to clients, and encourage them to rate you. Higher ratings increase your visibility and bookings.
helpCenter.cat_security_q1: How do I secure my account?
helpCenter.cat_security_a1: Use a strong password, enable two-factor authentication, and never share your login details. ONE TOUCH never asks for passwords via email.
helpCenter.cat_security_a2: No, each person should have one account. Having multiple accounts violates our terms and may result in permanent ban.
helpCenter.cat_security_q3: What if I forget my password?
helpCenter.cat_security_a3: Click "Forgot Password" on the login page and follow the email instructions. If you don't receive the email, check your spam folder.
helpCenter.cat_security_q4: How is my personal data protected?
helpCenter.cat_security_a4: We use bank-level encryption and security measures. Your data is never shared with third parties without your consent. See our Privacy Policy for details.

about.hero_subtitle: ONE TOUCH is building the trusted digital infrastructure for service delivery in Addis Ababa and beyond. We believe in transparent communication, secure transactions, and empowering local professionals.
about.story_p1: In Ethiopia, finding trusted service providers has been challenging. People worry about safety, transparent pricing, and payment security. Professionals struggle to build reputation and reach customers reliably.
about.story_p2: ONE TOUCH was created to solve this problem. We built a platform that combines identity verification, secure in-app communication, escrow protection, and digital payments. It's the bridge between clients and professionals — safe, instant, and transparent.
about.story_p3: Our mission is simple: empower Ethiopians to connect, serve, and grow. One touch. One transaction. One community.
about.mission_text: To connect trusted service providers with clients through secure digital infrastructure, enabling transparent communication, fair pricing, and reliable transactions in Ethiopia.
about.vision_text: A thriving ecosystem where every professional can reach their potential and every client can find trusted help instantly. Empowering local businesses and building a digital Ethiopia.
about.value_trust_desc: Every provider is government-ID verified. We build on trust, not just ratings.
about.value_speed_desc: Book in minutes, connect instantly. One tap away from getting help.
about.value_local_desc: Built for Addis Ababa and Ethiopia. Understanding local needs and culture.
about.value_community_desc: Supporting local professionals and businesses. Growing together.
about.commitment_text: ONE TOUCH is committed to empowering local service providers, informal sector workers, and small businesses in Ethiopia. We provide fair opportunities, secure payment channels, and digital visibility. Together, we're building a more connected, trustworthy, and prosperous economy.
about.cta_sub: Whether you're a client looking for trusted help or a professional ready to grow — let's transform service delivery in Ethiopia together.

privacyPolicy.page_sub: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. Last updated: February 2026.
privacyPolicy.contact_body: Email us at privacy@onetouch.et or contact our support team anytime.
privacyPolicy.s1_content: We collect information you provide directly (name, email, phone, payment details) and information automatically when you use the platform (IP address, device info, usage patterns). We also collect data from third parties when you authorize them (e.g., payment processors).
privacyPolicy.s2_content: We use your information to provide and improve our services, process payments, communicate with you, prevent fraud, comply with legal requirements, and personalize your experience. Your data is never sold to third parties without explicit consent.
privacyPolicy.s3_content: We implement bank-level encryption and security measures to protect your personal and financial data. All data is transmitted securely over HTTPS, and sensitive information is encrypted in storage. We regularly audit our security practices.
privacyPolicy.s4_content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You can opt out of marketing communications anytime. To exercise these rights, contact our privacy team at privacy@onetouch.et.
privacyPolicy.s5_content: We use trusted third-party services (payment processors, analytics, hosting providers). These partners have their own privacy policies and security measures. We only share data necessary for them to provide their services.
privacyPolicy.s6_content: We use cookies to remember your preferences and improve your experience. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features may not work properly. We do not track you across third-party websites.
privacyPolicy.s7_content: ONE TOUCH is not intended for users under 18. We do not knowingly collect information from minors. If we discover a user is under 18, we will delete their account and data immediately.
privacyPolicy.s8_content: We may update this privacy policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes via email or prominent notification on the platform. Your continued use of ONE TOUCH after changes constitutes acceptance.
